body_markdown:
A new partnership aims to turn a 250-nautical-mile stretch of sparsely populated sky between West Texas and southern New Mexico into a high-speed testing corridor for supersonic jets and commercial spacecraft.


The Midland Development Corporation, Midland International Air & Space Port, the New Mexico Spaceport Authority and Starfighters Space, Inc. announced the agreement Nov. 18. The authority operates Spaceport America. Both spaceports hold Federal Aviation Administration launch site operator licenses.
